page: Microsoft Azure D48ds_v5 is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the DDSv5 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 48 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 24 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8370C processor operating at 2.8 GHz. The architecture is x86_64, supported by 192.0 GB of system memory, which equates to 4.0 GB of RAM per core. The processor includes L1d cache of 48 KB, L2 cache of 1 MB, and L3 cache of 48 MB, alongside hardware flags such as AVX, AVX-512, AES, VAES, and SHA-NI.

This server includes 1843 GB of local SSD storage and is capable of utilizing Premium Storage. It does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The bundled local storage provides a high-density resource profile for workloads requiring fast local read and write operations without relying solely on network-attached storage.

Benchmark evaluations position the D48ds_v5 in the average tier for most compute and memory tasks, with a Passmark CPU score of 48717.7 and a multi-core Geekbench score of 15064.0. However, it demonstrates strong performance in specific areas, including Passmark database operations and CPU encryption, both ranking in the top 25%. Memory performance is also strong, with a Passmark memory score of 2757.12. For language model tasks, the server achieves a strong text generation speed of 275.95 tokens per second on a small 135M model, though performance drops to a weak 2.74 tokens per second for text generation on a large 70B model.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the D48ds_v5 offers a balanced resource density of compute, memory, and high-capacity local storage. This makes it a viable option for database hosting, web serving, and moderate data processing tasks where local disk performance is critical. It is less suited for large-scale LLM text generation due to the lack of GPU acceleration and the observed performance degradation on larger models.
description: Microsoft Azure D48ds_v5 is an x86_64 general-purpose virtual machine from the DDSv5 family, powered by a 2.8 GHz Intel Xeon 8370C processor. It features 48 dedicated vCPUs, 192.0 GB of RAM, and 1843 GB of bundled local SSD storage. Running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, the instance supports AVX-512, VAES, and SHA-NI instructions. Benchmark data indicates average multi-core CPU performance, but strong results in database operations, memory performance, and CPU encryption. While it handles small-scale LLM text generation efficiently, performance drops significantly on larger models. This server is best suited for database hosting, web serving, and general-purpose enterprise workloads requiring high local storage capacity.
